headline: Government of India makes substantial acquisition disclosure in NBCC (India) Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Government of India, via the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) signalling a substantial acquisition in or change in shareholding of NBCC (India) Limited. The filing was submitted to NSE on 17 June 2026, triggering mandatory disclosure obligations under the Takeover Code.
detail: Sandeep Kulharia, on behalf of the Government of India (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs), submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure when an acquiror crosses the 5% threshold of shares or voting rights, or intends to acquire 25% or more. The filing indicates either a crossed-5% position or an intention announcement. NBCC is a listed government enterprise engaged in EPC, real estate development, and urban infrastructure. The specific stake percentage, consideration value, and timeline for completion are not disclosed in the available abstract; the full disclosure form would contain acquisition price, earnout triggers, and conditions precedent.
